StorePricingConfig.title: StorePricingConfig
StorePricingConfig.description: Global storefront pricing, shipping thresholds, payment toggles, and featured promotional settings synchronized live to all shoppers.

discoverySetPrice.description: Live MRP price in INR for the 4 x 5ml Discovery Set (1 to 100000).

discoverySetInStock.description: Whether the Discovery Set is currently available for purchase.

fragrancePrices.description: Map of fragrance product IDs to their live MRP price in INR.

fragranceStock.description: Map of fragrance product IDs to in-stock availability booleans.

shippingFee.description: Standard express shipping fee in INR when below free shipping threshold (0 to 5000).

freeShippingThreshold.description: Minimum cart subtotal in INR to unlock complimentary shipping (0 to 100000).

codEnabled.description: Whether Cash on Delivery (COD) is enabled at checkout.

codFee.description: Optional additional handling fee in INR for Cash on Delivery orders (0 to 1000).

prepaidEnabled.description: Whether Prepaid (UPI / Card) checkout is enabled.

featuredCouponCode.description: Uppercase coupon code highlighted across hero, marquee, product cards, and cart drawer.

promoBannerText.description: Optional custom promotional copy displayed on the storefront.

updatedBy.description: Email of the verified administrator who last published pricing changes.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last pricing update.

Coupon.title: Coupon
Coupon.description: Live discount coupon code managed by administrators and validated in real time on the storefront cart.

code.description: Unique uppercase coupon code matching document ID.

description.description: Human-readable description of the promotional offer.

discountType.description: Whether the discount is a fixed INR amount or a percentage.

applyPerItem.description: For fixed discounts, whether to apply per unit/line item or once per order.

minOrderAmount.description: Minimum cart subtotal in INR required to apply this coupon.

maxDiscount.description: Maximum discount cap in INR (0 means uncapped up to subtotal).

active.description: Whether shoppers can currently redeem this coupon.

usageCount.description: Number of times this coupon has been redeemed.

maxUses.description: Optional maximum redemptions allowed (0 means unlimited).

createdBy.description: Email of the verified admin who created this coupon.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when coupon was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when coupon was last modified.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Customer order record tracking COD or Prepaid payment status, shipping PII, items, and fulfillment lifecycle. Strictly readable by verified admins only.

orderNumber.description: Unique human-readable order reference number matching document ID.

items.description: Bounded list (1 to 20) of purchased items with snapshot pricing.

couponCode.description: Coupon code applied at checkout, or empty string if none.

codFee.description: Additional COD handling charge in INR (0 for prepaid).

totalPrice.description: Final payable order total in INR.

paymentType.description: Whether the order is Cash on Delivery (cod) or Paid Before (prepaid).

paymentMethod.description: Specific payment channel chosen at checkout.

paymentReference.description: Optional UPI UTR or transaction reference for prepaid orders.

trackingNumber.description: Courier AWB or tracking code assigned by admin.

trackingKey.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex digest linking this order to its PII-free customer tracking document.

adminNotes.description: Internal concierge and dispatch notes editable only by admins.

updatedBy.description: Admin email who last modified the order.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when order was placed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

OrderTracking.title: OrderTracking
OrderTracking.description: PII-free customer order status projection keyed by a 40-char SHA-256 digest of orderNumber + email. Strictly get-only (no list queries) to prevent enumeration.

trackingKey.description: SHA-256 hex digest matching the document ID.

customerFirstName.description: Customer first name only (no email, phone, or street address).

items.description: Bounded list (1 to 20) of purchased items.

couponCode.description: Applied coupon code or empty string.

paymentType.description: Cash on Delivery or Paid Before.

fulfillmentStatus.description: Live fulfillment stage updated by admin.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when order was placed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest fulfillment update.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator registry record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authorized admin.

role.description: Role tier; only owner can grant or revoke admin access.

addedBy.description: Email of the owner who provisioned this admin.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when admin access was granted.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable append-only security and operations audit log recording every admin action.

actorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator performing the action.

actorEmail.description: Verified email of the administrator performing the action.

targetId.description: Document ID or resource identifier affected by the action.

summary.description: Human-readable audit summary of what changed.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of the audit event.

/store_config/{configId}.description: Singleton global storefront pricing and promotional configuration document (/store_config/pricing).

/coupons/{couponId}.description: Live coupon codes keyed by uppercase code string.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer orders containing COD/Prepaid status, items, and shipping PII. Strictly admin-readable/updatable/deletable only.

/order_tracking/{trackingKey}.description: PII-free customer order tracking projection keyed by SHA-256(orderNumber|email). Get-only (no list) for customers; admin-updatable/deletable.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Registry of verified administrators authorized to operate the TRACE Admin Panel.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Append-only security audit trail of all admin operations.
